narr: A monsoon surge occurred on Sunday August 11, 2024. Numerous strong to severe thunderstorms erupted across the San Diego mountains and into the Riverside County mountains. Thunderstorms produced hail, wind gusts and rainfall rates of 1 inch in 60 minutes.
ev: San Diego department of Public Works reported mud flows and flash flooding on the Great Southern Overland Stage route S2 and Vallecito Wash crossings. 2.54 inches of rain was recorded. Public Works also provided photos of the flooding and NWS did a storm survey the next day.

Anza Borrego State Park reported, video taped and photographs flash flooding from Fish Creek and across Split Mountain Road. Runoff caused damage to paved road. NWS Kineros modeling predicted 4 to 5 feet water levels at the exit of Fish Creek canyons before Split mountain road on the San Diego County side.
